units: hbar=e-unit=cube-edge-length=1. Dimensionless energies are in selected input omega units; qvector components have inverse-edge units, not infinite-periodic reciprocal labels.

functions.build(p, flavors=(0,1,2)): Return full sparse same-law H and metadata. Basis ordered hard-core flavor positions, selected spin index, field mask0..255. Local field bit v is the literal local n=0,1 occupation. Metadata includes positions/spins, primitive charges, actual site loads, pair spin operators/distances, eight b_v and local occupation table.
functions.sector_embedding(meta, parity=(0,0,0)): Exact normalized simultaneous XOR graph-automorphism embedding; spatial matter and neutral field labels both permute. parity uses low bit first (Cartesian z,y,x respectively). Graph reflections are not continuum translations.
functions.density(qvector, meta): Return diagonal rho=sum_i qi exp(+i qvector.r_xi) over full state basis. rho(0)=1 for three-flavor sector.
functions.current_contact(p, qvector, polarization: Return full sparse Peierls current and second derivative (+q,-q) contact for selected Cartesian plane-wave polarization. J=-dH/dA(-q). C=d2H/dA(q)dA(-q). For polarization parallel to q, [H,rho]=|q|J. Neutral fields carry no direct electric charge but participate dynamically in states/response.
functions.spectral_measure(h, energy, source, step: Pure frozen helper returning finite Krylov gaps/weights and physical source norm. Not asserted full exact Lehmann spectrum.
functions.retarded(measure, frequencies, eta): Pure frozen helper for inversion/reflection-equal opposite-q autocorrelation measures. Finite eta>0, response sum w[(omega-gap+i eta)^-1-(omega+gap+i eta)^-1]. Not a mixed tensor API.
functions.fragmentation(p, energy): Return all three disconnected-copy pair+single finite-cube reference energies and margin Epair+Esingle-Etarget. Distinct from infinite-volume or same-small-cube separation thresholds.

state_scope: Actual1 prepares lowest even graph sector in Sz=+1/2. NEW selection1 computes ALL8 graph-representation low states for full trimer, all pairs and g0; every selected ground is even000, so actual1 is the selected finite ground within its spin block. Actual S2, position-spin and local-field correlations are measured; all response/recoil receivers use that same-H state. No continuum on-shell proton assertion.
moving_receiver: Serialized full ground state and whole odd target blocks in receipt.npz; lowest odd-block elastic vertices in receipt.json. No external electron/photon mass, vertex, state or normalization is adopted.
cooperation_control: selection.py capped_shared_load replaces local L_v by min(L_v,.5) and retains the full dynamic field. Actual shared loading gives .9538646709 additional ground lowering, but capped law still binds>=.3725616116; g0 alone removes binding. No claim of exclusively cooperative binding.
join_status: Separate new local-composite root. Structural charge/current API is useful for a receiver willing to adopt this same cube law and state; it is not compatible by name alone with the four-site Hubbard/Gauss roots.
